title: Fishy Hub | Full Auto Fish, Auto Roll, Auto Quest, n More
features:
This automation suite for Sol's RNG provides a comprehensive set of features organized through a clean user interface. The rolling system automatically rolls with smart decision-making, using rarity filters, target hunting for specific auras, blacklisting unwanted auras, and webhook notifications for rare finds. It includes auto-boosts for consumable items, ground item collection, and protection for valuable potions and materials. The crafting module handles gear, potions, and equipment farming, while the quests system automates daily, side, and story quests along with achievements and season pass rewards. Fishing is fully automated with cast timing, net sessions, and fish selling with protected fish lists. The suite also includes merchant exchanges, daily shop purchases, memory match and world activity participation, visual enhancements like ESP highlights, and performance optimization features such as hiding other players' auras. All features are configurable through an intuitive UI with session statistics, roll history, profile saving, and Discord webhook integration.
